You will own the strategy and roadmap for preventing fake account creation, bots and fake traffic, SMS abuse, email abuse, affiliate and benefits abuse, and the handling of third-party abuse complaints.
 Abuse on HighLevel shows up on many surfaces at once: signup, public forms, messaging, affiliates, funnels and websites, domains, and AI agents. You will build the detection layer, a shared definition of an abusive account, and the graduated enforcement system that stops abuse early while keeping friction off legitimate businesses.
 You will set requirements and shared standards for integrity across the platform, and partner with the engineering teams that own each surface to build on work they already have in flight. Success in this role depends on strong cross-team leadership, crisp prioritization, and the ability to make a data-backed case for integrity work across many roadmaps.

 Customer First — Only Promise What Can Be Delivered

Interest in astrology, spirituality or wellness products.
